user_persona: Junior Applied AI Engineer / General Developer
pain_point: The Cost and COPQ timeline chart is completely missing numerical labels or dollar units on the Y-axis. I can see the lines scrolling and intersecting, but I have no way of knowing if the token cost is $0.0001 or $10.00. The scale is completely invisible.

The alert builder form uses confusing jargon like 'Window (traces)' and 'Min Samples' without tooltips or labels. As a user, I don't know if 'Window' refers to time in minutes or count of requests. Also, the latency slider threshold lacks units (ms vs seconds).

When expanding a trace, the Prompt and Response text boxes have no copy-to-clipboard shortcut. When troubleshooting an evaluation failure, I have to highlight and copy the prompt manually to test it in Python. A simple click-to-copy button is missing.
